part_name: 2N5087 (Motorola small-signal PNP, TO-92) - PROXY for the PNP small-signal class, not a project part
obtained_by: AI agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5, sourcing agent, L44) on behalf of roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
obtained_from: https://www.mit.edu/~6.301/2N5087o.pdf (MIT 6.301 course copy of the Motorola 'Small-Signal Transistors, FETs and Diodes Device Data' sheet). A copy, not the manufacturer host. Byte-for-byte as served.
license_notes: Historic manufacturer datasheet kept unmodified for engineering traceability; copyright remains the original owner.
why_this_part: Only published frequency-resolved noise-current curves found for a small-signal PNP at several collector currents. Used for a class limit on KF/AF of PNP bipolars (the project's MMBT5401 and LS350 have no such curve).

noise_evidence.where: PDF page 3 (printed page 3), 'TYPICAL NOISE CHARACTERISTICS', Figure 1 (noise voltage, Rs ~ 0) and Figure 2 (noise current, Rs ~ infinity). Raster/vector render read by eye.
noise_evidence.conditions: Vce = -5 V, TA = 25 C, bandwidth 1 Hz, Ic = 10, 30, 100, 300 uA and 1 mA; f = 10 Hz .. 10 kHz
noise_evidence.reading_uncertainty: about +/-10-15 percent on the value; curves are smoothed 'typical'
noise_evidence.consistency_check: White floor at 10 uA = 0.11 pA matches 2qIb for Ib = 40 nA (hFE ~ 250): 0.10 pA. Floor at 1 mA = 1.3 pA vs 2qIb at Ib = 4 uA = 1.1 pA. So the curves are base-current shot + 1/f.

derived_by_agent_not_published.assumed_hFE: 250 (datasheet min for this part; real value unknown)
derived_by_agent_not_published.spectral_slope_note: At 1 mA the excess falls as f^-0.7 between 10 and 290 Hz, not f^-1; fitting at ~300 Hz instead gives KF about 5e-14 with the same AF.

what_was_not_verified: Not the project's part and a different die (2N5087 is a very-high-gain low-noise type). Not read from the manufacturer's own host.
